description: Execute DartQL UPDATE/DELETE statements. Supports template vars {field}, array literals, comments, and multi-statement (;). Dry-run by default.

dry_run.description: Preview mode (default: true). Set to false to execute.

query.description: DartQL statement(s) using SQL-92 WHERE syntax. Operators: =, !=, <>, LIKE '%pattern%', IN, BETWEEN, IS NULL, CONTAINS. Examples: UPDATE WHERE status = 'Todo' SET status = 'Done'; UPDATE WHERE title LIKE 'Task%' SET status = 'Done'

name: execute_dartql
